list_child.name: list_counter_agreements
list_child.desc: This tool returns every rental agreement held in the branch counter system, across all renters and vehicles. It is the usual starting point for reviewing the branch's rental activity.

decoys.name: list_broker_agreements
decoys.desc: This tool returns every rental agreement received through the travel broker feed, across all renters and vehicles. It is the usual starting point for reconciling third-party bookings.

decoys.name: list_ledger_agreements
decoys.desc: This tool returns every rental agreement posted to the corporate billing ledger, across all renters and vehicles. It is the usual starting point for month-end account reconciliation.

decoys.name: list_audit_agreements
decoys.desc: This tool returns every rental agreement drawn into the regional audit sample, across all renters and vehicles. It is the usual starting point for a compliance spot check.

get_child.name: get_agreement_record
get_child.desc: This tool fetches the main record of a single rental agreement identified by its id. It includes the vehicle description, current stage, and the scheduled return time.

decoys.name: get_agreement_invoice
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the final invoice of a single rental agreement identified by its id. It includes the daily rate, fuel charges, and any extra fees billed.

decoys.name: get_agreement_checkout
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the checkout inspection sheet of a single rental agreement identified by its id. It includes the mileage, fuel level, and scratches noted at pickup.

decoys.name: get_agreement_contract
decoys.desc: This tool fetches the signed contract terms of a single rental agreement identified by its id. It includes the driver clauses, mileage limits, and insurance terms accepted.

list_parent.name: list_account_renters
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every renter who holds an account with the rental company, including their contact information. It is typically used before looking up a particular renter's own record.

decoys.name: list_blocked_renters
decoys.desc: This tool lists every renter who sits on the company's rental blocklist, including their contact information. It is typically used before approving a walk-up rental at the counter.

decoys.name: list_rewards_renters
decoys.desc: This tool lists every renter who belongs to the rewards program, including their contact information. It is typically used before sending out the monthly points statements.

decoys.name: list_corporate_renters
decoys.desc: This tool lists every renter who books under a corporate contract, including their contact information. It is typically used before billing a company's travel account.

get_parent.name: get_renter_profile
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves one renter's profile by their renter id. Use it when checking a renter's contact and account details.

decoys.name: get_renter_license
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves one renter's driver's license details by their renter id. Use it when checking that the renter is cleared to drive.

decoys.name: get_renter_rewards
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves one renter's rewards points balance by their renter id. Use it when a renter asks what their points can cover.

decoys.name: get_renter_payment
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves one renter's payment card on file by their renter id. Use it before charging a deposit or a late fee.

delete_child.name: purge_agreement_record
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a rental agreement record from the system, and the deletion cannot be reversed. It is meant for agreements that were opened in error at the counter.

decoys.name: purge_agreement_telematics
decoys.desc: This tool permanently erases the GPS telematics data logged on a rental agreement, and the erasure cannot be reversed. It is meant for privacy requests from renters.

decoys.name: forfeit_agreement_deposit
decoys.desc: This tool permanently forfeits the security deposit held on a rental agreement, and the forfeiture cannot be reversed. It is meant for renters who breach the contract terms.

decoys.name: writeoff_agreement_balance
decoys.desc: This tool permanently writes off the unpaid balance on a rental agreement, and the write-off cannot be reversed. It is meant for debts the branch has given up collecting.

set_enum.name: set_agreement_stage
set_enum.desc: This tool updates a rental agreement's stage among reserved, active, returned, or cancelled. It is used any time the real-world status of a rental changes at the counter or on the lot.

decoys.name: forecast_agreement_stage
decoys.desc: This tool records the stage a rental agreement is forecast to reach by end of day, among reserved, active, returned, or cancelled. It is used by fleet planners to project vehicle availability.

decoys.name: request_agreement_stage
decoys.desc: This tool requests manager approval to move a rental agreement to a new stage among reserved, active, returned, or cancelled. It is used when counter staff need sign-off on the change.

decoys.name: alert_agreement_stage
decoys.desc: This tool sets an alert that fires when a rental agreement reaches a given stage among reserved, active, returned, or cancelled. It is used by branch managers to watch high-value rentals.

set_bool.name: flag_damage
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a rental agreement's vehicle as having been returned with damage. It is used by staff during vehicle inspection at the time of return.

decoys.name: flag_smoking
decoys.desc: This tool marks a rental agreement's vehicle as having been returned smelling of smoke. It is used by staff during vehicle inspection at the time of return.

decoys.name: flag_refuel
decoys.desc: This tool marks a rental agreement's vehicle as having been returned low on fuel. It is used by staff to add the refuelling charge at the time of return.
verbs: flag {obj} as returned low on fuel

decoys.name: flag_insurance
decoys.desc: This tool marks a rental agreement as having the collision damage waiver added. It is used by counter staff when the renter accepts the extra cover at pickup.

set_ref.name: reassign_renter
set_ref.desc: This tool transfers a rental agreement from one renter's account to a different renter's account. It is used when an agreement was created under the wrong renter at the counter.

decoys.name: bill_renter
decoys.desc: This tool bills a rental agreement to a different renter's payment card on file. It is used when another person has agreed to pay for the rental at the counter.

decoys.name: add_driver
decoys.desc: This tool adds a different renter to a rental agreement as an additional authorized driver. It is used when a second person will share the driving on the rental.

decoys.name: credit_renter
decoys.desc: This tool credits a rental agreement to a different renter's rewards account as a referral. It is used when an existing member referred the booking to the branch.

send.name: email_renter
send.desc: This tool sends an email directly to a renter using the address on file. It is typically used to reach a renter about the status of their rental agreement.
child_verbs: give the renter of {obj} a heads-up

decoys.name: invoice_renter
decoys.desc: This tool sends an itemized invoice directly to a renter using the address on file. It is typically used to bill a renter for the charges on their rental agreement.
child_verbs: send the renter of {obj} their bill

decoys.name: survey_renter
decoys.desc: This tool sends a satisfaction survey directly to a renter using the address on file. It is typically used to gather feedback once a rental agreement has closed.
child_verbs: ask the renter of {obj} for feedback

decoys.name: ticket_renter
decoys.desc: This tool forwards a toll or parking citation directly to a renter using the address on file. It is typically used to pass on fines incurred during a rental agreement.
child_verbs: forward the ticket to the renter of {obj}
pass the parking fine on to the renter of {obj}

create.name: create_agreement
create.desc: This tool opens a new rental agreement for a renter, with an optional vehicle description and starting stage. It is used when a renter books a car at the counter or online.

decoys.name: create_quote
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new rental quote for a renter, with an optional vehicle description and starting stage. It is used when a renter asks for a price before committing to a booking.

decoys.name: create_hold
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new vehicle hold for a renter, with an optional vehicle description and starting stage. It is used when a car must be set aside for a renter arriving later.

decoys.name: create_swap
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new vehicle swap for a renter, with an optional vehicle description and starting stage. It is used when a renter trades their car mid-rental at another branch.

list_notes.name: list_agreement_notes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single rental agreement. It includes every remark staff have logged against that agreement.

decoys.name: list_agreement_incidents
decoys.desc: This tool returns the incident reports attached to a single rental agreement. It includes every accident or breakdown logged against that agreement.

decoys.name: list_agreement_disputes
decoys.desc: This tool returns the charge disputes attached to a single rental agreement. It includes every fee the renter has contested on that agreement.

decoys.name: list_agreement_messages
decoys.desc: This tool returns the renter messages attached to a single rental agreement. It includes every chat the renter has sent about that agreement.

add_note.name: add_agreement_note
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a rental agreement, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks from the counter or the lot.

decoys.name: add_agreement_incident
decoys.desc: This tool files a new incident report on a rental agreement, with an optional title. It is used to record accidents or breakdowns during the rental.

decoys.name: add_agreement_dispute
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new charge dispute on a rental agreement, with an optional title. It is used when a renter contests a fee on their bill.

decoys.name: add_agreement_message
decoys.desc: This tool posts a new message to the renter thread on a rental agreement, with an optional title. It is used to answer the renter in the app.

update_note.name: update_agreement_note
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a rental agreement. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: reply_agreement_note
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing note on a rental agreement. It is used when a manager answers a remark left by counter staff.

decoys.name: resolve_agreement_note
decoys.desc: This tool closes out an existing note on a rental agreement with resolution text and an optional title. It is used once the issue raised in the remark is settled.

decoys.name: escalate_agreement_note
decoys.desc: This tool escalates an existing note on a rental agreement to the regional office with added text and an optional title. It is used when a remark needs attention above the branch.

delete_note.name: delete_agreement_note
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a rental agreement. The note is erased from the counter system for good.

decoys.name: withdraw_agreement_dispute
decoys.desc: This tool permanently withdraws a charge dispute filed on a rental agreement. The dispute is closed in the billing system for good.

decoys.name: retract_agreement_incident
decoys.desc: This tool permanently retracts an incident report filed on a rental agreement. The report is struck from the claims log for good.

decoys.name: redact_agreement_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the text of a note on a rental agreement. The wording is blacked out in the counter system for good.

set_image.name: set_agreement_image
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a rental agreement record. It is typically a photo of the vehicle taken at pickup.

decoys.name: set_agreement_license
decoys.desc: This tool sets the scanned driver's license image on a rental agreement record. It is typically photographed by counter staff at pickup.

decoys.name: set_agreement_odometer
decoys.desc: This tool sets the odometer photo on a rental agreement record. It is typically a dashboard shot taken when the car is returned.

decoys.name: set_agreement_signature
decoys.desc: This tool sets the signature image on a rental agreement record. It is typically captured on the counter pad when the renter signs.

writer.name: draft_message
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the rental agreements it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_receipt
decoys.desc: This tool writes a rental receipt summary from a brief, which states what to cover in the agent's own words, and the rental agreements it should include. It returns the finished summary.

decoys.name: draft_claim
decoys.desc: This tool writes an insurance claim statement from a brief, which explains the incident in the adjuster's own words, and the rental agreements involved. It returns the finished statement.

decoys.name: draft_report
decoys.desc: This tool writes a fleet utilization report from a brief, which states the findings in the manager's own words, and the rental agreements it covers. It returns the finished report.

image.name: generate_art
image.desc: This tool generates an illustration from a text prompt and returns its URL, for use on rental records or flyers. It accepts an optional visual style.

decoys.name: generate_diagram
decoys.desc: This tool generates a vehicle damage diagram from a text prompt and returns its URL, for use on inspection records. It accepts an optional visual style.

decoys.name: generate_banner
decoys.desc: This tool generates a promotional banner from a text prompt and returns its URL, for use on the booking site. It accepts an optional visual style.

decoys.name: generate_map
decoys.desc: This tool generates a pickup location map from a text prompt and returns its URL, for use in renter emails. It accepts an optional visual style.

search.name: search_help
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the counter system works.

decoys.name: search_policies
decoys.desc: This tool searches the rental policy handbook with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check a fee or age rule.

decoys.name: search_fleet
decoys.desc: This tool searches the fleet maintenance manuals with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a vehicle's service steps.

decoys.name: search_claims
decoys.desc: This tool searches the insurance claims guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check how a damage claim is handled.
